from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u007/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A full uniform line separates two equal-sized panels.
    split = None
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and r > 0 and h - r - 1 == r:
            split = ("h", r)
            break
    if split is None:
        for c in range(w):
            col = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
            if len(set(col)) == 1 and c > 0 and w - c - 1 == c:
                split = ("v", c)
                break
    if split is None:
        raise ValueError("No centered uniform separator")
    axis, k = split
    if axis == "h":
        a, b = grid[:k], grid[k+1:]
    else:
        a = [row[:k] for row in grid]
        b = [row[k+1:] for row in grid]
    common = set(map(set, a)) & set(map(set, b))
    # Palette intersection, rather than per-row intersection.
    pa = set(v for row in a for v in row)
    pb = set(v for row in b for v in row)
    shared = pa & pb
    if len(shared) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected one shared panel color, got {shared}")
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if x == color and y == color else color for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
'''
